name: Teenage Pregnancy
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of pregnancy and the responsibilities it entails, as seen in Exodus 22:16 where a man who lies with an unmarried woman is commanded to marry and provide for her. The sanctity of marriage is upheld in Hebrews 13:4, emphasizing that the marriage bed is honorable and undefiled. The experiences of childbirth are poignantly described in John 16:21 and Revelation 12:2, highlighting both the pain and the joy that accompany bringing new life into the world. The example of the mother of Jesus at a wedding in John 2:1 further reflects the God-ordained context of family and marriage.
